description: Hand-built TracksTimeline inputs for evaluate_intrusion()'s gap-tolerance behavior, exercised directly (no build_tracks_timeline()/reid/calibration involved). intrusion_gap_frames=2 matches SECURITY_RULES's default -- tests_manual/test_events.py builds each track's observation list from frame_indices, all inside the single restricted+always-armed zone below.

one_frame_gap.description: Track 1 observed at frames 10-14, then again at frame 16 (frame 15 missing -- a 1-frame gap). diff(14, 16)=2 <= gap_tolerance(2)+1=3, so this stays ONE continuous run.

exceeding_gap.description: Track 2 observed at frames 10-14, then again at frame 18 (frames 15,16,17 missing -- a 3-frame gap). diff(14, 18)=4 > gap_tolerance(2)+1=3, so this splits into TWO separate runs/events.
